request.description: Requires a console user with write:networks. The author is assigned from the authenticated user. Supply a new random UUID client_reference for each note; retry the same body and reference after an uncertain response to avoid duplicates. Reusing a reference for another body, author or network returns 409. Notes follow the surviving investigation when networks merge.

request.description: Download a PDF of the current organization network, its observed account connections, signal references and review status. Requires read:networks. Global intelligence and private analyst notes are not included. Each account and signal list is capped at 500 entries and the report states when it is incomplete. The request does not change network status. Errors are returned as JSON.

response.name: Network evidence report. Cache-Control: no-store.

Comma-separated bands: low,medium,high.

Maximum member count.
Lower bound on last_activity_at (ISO 8601 date or datetime).
Upper bound on first_activity_at (ISO 8601 date or datetime).
Free-text search across network name, member names, the network_id (N-0001), and exact pattern_type tokens.
One of risk_score, -risk_score, last_activity_at, -last_activity_at, first_activity_at, -first_activity_at, network_number, -network_number. Defaults to -risk_score,-last_activity_at.

Zero-based offset of the first record.

request.description: List fraud networks detected within this application's organization, newest activity first by default. By default dismissed networks are excluded; pass status to include them. Sandbox applications never have networks - clustering excludes sandbox data entirely.
